literal: Muzong, Part One
idiomatic: Muzong, Part One

literal: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright — personal name Jing, courtesy name Shulü.
idiomatic: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright, whose personal name was Jing and whose courtesy name was Shulü.

literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Taizong; his mother was Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.
idiomatic: Eldest son of Emperor Taizong, born to Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.

literal: In the second year of Huitong he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou'an.
idiomatic: In the second year of Huitong he received the title Prince of Shou'an.

literal: In the fifth year of Tianlu, in the ninth month of autumn, on guihai day, Shizong met with assassination.
idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianlu, on guihai day in the ninth month of autumn, Shizong was assassinated.

literal: The treacherous ministers Chage and others were executed.
idiomatic: The rebel Chage and his accomplices were put to death.

literal: On dingmao day he ascended the imperial throne; the assembled ministers offered the elevated title Emperor of Heavenly Accord, and the era name was changed to Yingli.
idiomatic: On dingmao day he took the throne; the court invested him as Emperor of Heavenly Accord and changed the era name to Yingli.

literal: On wuchen day he went to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

literal: That month Liu Chengxun was dispatched to announce the mourning to Han.
idiomatic: That month Liu Chengxun was sent to Han to announce the Emperor's bereavement.

literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each sent envoys to offer condolences.
idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each dispatched envoys of condolence.

literal: On yihai day an edict ordered court assemblies to follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng, using Han ritual.
idiomatic: On yihai day an edict directed that court assemblies follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng and adopt Han court ritual.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys presenting bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys with bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.

literal: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both brought tribute.

literal: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first month of spring, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter and presenting ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.
idiomatic: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first spring month, Southern Tang sent envoys with a wax-sealed letter and ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.

literal: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi plotted rebellion and was executed.
idiomatic: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi was executed for plotting rebellion.

literal: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang dispatched envoys with a wax-sealed letter.

literal: On dingmao day they again sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys again.

literal: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was appointed Great King of the Southern Court.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was made Great King of the Southern Court.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: That summer, on the bingxu new moon of the fourth month, the sun was eclipsed.

literal: On jihai day Tieli presented hunting hawks and falcons.
idiomatic: On jihai day Tieli presented hawks and falcons for the hunt.

literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen new moon, he held court.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month the Emperor held court.

literal: On renwu day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On renwu day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor of State Affairs Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Academician of the Hall of Promulgating Governance Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; when the plot was discovered, an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Hall of Promulgating Governance academician Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; the plot was discovered, and an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.

literal: On yiwei day heaven and earth were sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: On renyin day Han, invaded by Zhou, sent envoys requesting aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to go to their assistance.
idiomatic: On renyin day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to their relief.

literal: On dingwei day the elder brother of the wet nurse, Helu Shi, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Helu Shi, elder brother of the wet nurse, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized on the spot.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized where they stood.

literal: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and the others were executed; Li Han was flogged and released.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Li Han was flogged and then released.

literal: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture presented auspicious grain with four stalks and two ears.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture reported auspicious grain of four stalks bearing two ears.

literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered that on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, white and black sheep and dark wine be used to sacrifice to heaven — established as an annual rite.
idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict established an annual rite: on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, heaven was to be sacrificed to with white and black sheep and dark wine.

literal: On renxu day he hunted at Mount Tanshan.
idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor hunted at Mount Tanshan.

literal: He sacrificed to heaven.
idiomatic: He performed the heaven sacrifice.

literal: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe brought tribute.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen new moon, Han sent envoys presenting grape wine.
idiomatic: That winter, on the jiashen new moon of the tenth month, Han sent envoys with grape wine.

literal: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants in tribute.

literal: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the guichou new moon, he held court.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor held court.

literal: On jisi day there was an earthquake.
idiomatic: On jisi day the earth quaked.

literal: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the old rite of bowing to the sun was performed for the first time.
idiomatic: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the court performed the old sun-bowing rite for the first time.

literal: The people of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.
idiomatic: Commoners of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the guiwei new moon, Gao Mohan and Han troops besieged Jin Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the twelfth month, Gao Mohan and Han forces laid siege to Jin Prefecture.

literal: On xinmao day, on his birthday, he fed the monks and released prisoners.
idiomatic: On xinmao day, his birthday, the Emperor fed the monks and released prisoners.

literal: On jiachen day he hunted in the near suburbs.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

literal: He sacrificed to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: He performed sacrifices to heaven and earth.

literal: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan died.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan passed away.

literal: In the third year, in the intercalary first month of spring, on the renwu new moon, because Gao Mohan had repelled the Zhou army, Han sent envoys to offer thanks.
idiomatic: In the third year, on the renwu new moon of the intercalary first spring month, Han sent envoys to give thanks after Gao Mohan had driven back the Zhou army.

literal: In the second month, on the xinhai new moon, an edict ordered use of Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal.
idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the second month an edict directed that Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal be used.

literal: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou city; Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, and he repulsed them.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou; when Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, he drove them back.

literal: In the third month, on the gengchen new moon, Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute and attached a letter for Han; an edict ordered it delivered.
idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent tribute envoys with a letter for Han; the Emperor ordered it forwarded.

literal: On gengyin day he went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.

literal: On dingyou day Han sent envoys presenting ball-playing gear and horses.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Han sent envoys with ball-playing equipment and horses.

literal: On gengzi day he watched fishing at Shende Lake.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor watched the fishing at Shende Lake.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, Tieli came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on gengshen day, Tieli brought tribute.

literal: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele erected by Later Jin for the late emperor had been destroyed by the people of Zhou, and requesting that it be carved again; permission was granted.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had destroyed the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele Later Jin had erected for the late emperor, and asking that it be recarved; the Emperor assented.

literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, the Empress Dowager Yingtian died.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Empress Dowager Yingtian passed away.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.

literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, on his birthday, prisoners were released.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi day, his birthday, the Emperor released prisoners.

literal: On jiwei day Han sent envoys requesting aid.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Han sent envoys begging military aid.

literal: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys presenting medicines.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys with medicines.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.

literal: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others — all were seized.
idiomatic: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was uncovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others, and all were arrested.

literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was given the posthumous title Chaste and Resolute and was buried at the ancestral tombs.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was posthumously titled Chaste and Resolute and interred at the ancestral tombs.

literal: Han sent envoys to attend the funeral.
idiomatic: Han dispatched envoys to attend the burial rites.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Fengsheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Fengsheng Prefecture.

literal: Because of flooding at the Southern Capital, an edict remitted that year's land tax.
idiomatic: Flooding at the Southern Capital prompted an edict remitting that year's land tax.

literal: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on wuyin day, the Uyghurs came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on wuyin day in the first month of spring, the Uyghurs brought tribute.

literal: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and the others were executed; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.
idiomatic: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.

literal: That month Zhou ruler Wei died; his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded to the throne.
idiomatic: That month Zhou's ruler Guo Wei died, and his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded him.

literal: In the second month, on the bingwu new moon, Zhou attacked Han; Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to go to their aid.
idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the second month, as Zhou attacked Han, Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to their relief.

literal: On bingchen day Han sent envoys presenting tea and medicines.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Han sent envoys with tea and medicines.

literal: He visited the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Southern Capital.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai day, Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han; Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to assist Dilu in suppressing them.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fifth month on yihai day, when Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han, Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to join Dilu in suppressing the revolt.

literal: On dingyou day Talie defeated Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Talie routed Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.

literal: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented what he had captured.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented his captives and booty.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou day, Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops; Han sent envoys requesting their return, and an edict ordered all of them restored.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on yiyou day, when Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops, Han sent envoys asking their return, and an edict ordered every one of them restored.

literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, Han, invaded by the people of Zhou, sent envoys to report it.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys to report the attack.

literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun memorialized the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.
idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun reported the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, he visited the ancestral tombs.
idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.

literal: On gengwu day Han sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Han sent tribute envoys.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Xingguo.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Xingguo.

literal: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first month of spring, Bigude came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first spring month, Bigude brought tribute.

literal: In the second month, on the gengzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.

literal: On gengshen day Han sent envoys requesting that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; it was not granted.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Han sent envoys asking that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; the request was refused.

literal: On renxu day he went to Tan.
idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor went to Tan.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Zhou invaded Han, and Han sent envoys requesting aid.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on jiyou day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid.

literal: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor.
idiomatic: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was made Northern Chancellery Chancellor.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day, the Han ruler fell ill and sent envoys to report it.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han fell ill and sent envoys to announce it.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on renshen day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On dinghai day he visited Taizong's temple.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor visited Taizong's temple.

literal: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the yiwei new moon, Han ruler Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys to announce the death and request recognition of his succession.
idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the eleventh month Han's ruler Liu Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys announcing the death and asking that his succession be recognized.

literal: Envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and perform the investiture; he was thereupon enfeoffed and invested.
idiomatic: The Emperor sent envoys to mourn and invest the new ruler, and Liu Chengjun was thereupon enfeoffed and confirmed in succession.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the yichou new moon, he visited Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Taizu's temple.

literal: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.

literal: In the sixth year, in the fifth month of summer, on dingyou day, he visited Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on dingyou day in the fifth month of summer, the Emperor visited Huai Mausoleum.

literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.

literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.
